mutant.description: Run in memory from .scratch/controls.py, with no tracked file edited. The script imports check_ln_r3.py. (a) AC1 mutant: tsv() is wrapped so that namer B's i05 name gets a '-mutant' suffix. (b) AC2 mutant: seat_parts() is wrapped so that seat B's record carries seat A's session_id and seat_dir. (c) AC2 mutant: seat B's prompt text gets one extra byte. Each arm is followed by an unmutated run of the same import.
mutant.expected: (a) VERDICT: FAIL-DIFFERENT with DIFFERENT: 1. (b) VERDICT: FAIL-NAMERS-NOT-SEPARATED. (c) VERDICT: FAIL-NAMERS-NOT-SEPARATED.
mutant.observed: (a) DIFFERS: i05  A=opal-data-cottonwood  B=opal-data-cottonwood-mutant / ITEMS: 18  IDENTICAL: 17  DIFFERENT: 1 / VERDICT: FAIL-DIFFERENT. The unmutated run gave VERDICT: PASS-IDENTICAL (18 of 18). (b) SESSION B: 11cdb5f4-... (A's) / VERDICT: FAIL-NAMERS-NOT-SEPARATED. (c) VERDICT: FAIL-NAMERS-NOT-SEPARATED. The unmutated run gave VERDICT: PASS-NAMERS-UNCONFERRED. So each checker can return FAIL, and the PASS is a result of the input. git status afterwards showed no tracked file modified.
